text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"སེམས་ནི་ཇི་སྐད་གསུངས་པའི་བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་སེམས་སོ།","english":"\"Mind\" is not the bodhicitta as previously described.","kind":"negation","why":"The English adds a \"not\" that contradicts the source's identification of the mind as bodhicitta.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: "Mind" is not the bodhicitta as previously described.
contradictions.why: The English adds a "not" that contradicts the source's identification of the mind as bodhicitta.
